selectedProblem: finishPreparationForEntry leaves its timer channel nil when 0 < remaining <= 300ms, so optional waiting can last until cleanup or the unrelated caller deadline.

reproduction.clock: Go testing/synctest virtual clock; not wall-clock or laptop measurements

change: Always create a timer for min(remaining preparation lifetime, InputPreparationEntryWait). Timer and caller cancellation share one cancellation exit.
ownership: Cancellation does not clear preparationCancel, close done, release installation pins or bypass input.mu. Entry still joins native cleanup before connecting a new worker.

validation.red: Unmodified source failed the 50ms and 300ms cases: each waited for the 1000ms caller timeout.

limits: The timer bounds only this optional completion wait. Native cleanup and the subsequent mutex acquisition retain their existing independent ownership and caller budget.
No claim that this alone resolves the observed worst-case physical handoff delay or service error 1066.
